'''Porrak Vansyn''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] on the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] in [[43 ABY]].

He was present on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Unification Summit|unification talks between the Galactic Alliance and the Imperial Remnant]]. He met with Moff [[Drikl Lecersen]] and the two discussed their discontent with having [[Jagged Fel]] ruling the Remnant as well as his relationship with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]. Vansyn and Lecersen both started to formulate plans to remove Fel as Head of State.

After the [[Plan Delta|coup]] that overthrew [[Natasi Daala]] as [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the Galactic Alliance, Fel announced his support to the coup and his belief that the Jedi were right to get rid of Daala. Although Fel did have a minority of supporters on the Moff Council such as Moff [[Tol Getelles]]. Most of them however, including Vansyn, were opposed to the coup and made no such secret by speaking to the press about their discontent.

==Behind the scenes==
Throughout ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'', Vansyn's first name is occasionally misspelled "Porak."
